Amazing Vietnamese Food and Wonderful Hospitality!
Oct 2026 • Couples
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Vietnamese Food and Wonderful Hospitality!

What a fantastic dining experience at Madame Thao in Ho Chi Minh City! The food was absolutely delicious, authentic, and full of flavour.

The Vietnamese pancake (Bánh Xèo) was definitely one of the highlights — beautifully crispy, flavourful, and simply irresistible! The tilapia fish was another standout dish, perfectly prepared and incredibly tasty. Both are absolute must-tries!

A special shoutout to Tom, our wonderful host, who made our visit even more memorable. He was incredibly friendly, attentive, and welcoming, making sure we had a fantastic dining experience from start to finish.

Great food, warm Vietnamese hospitality, and a lovely atmosphere. This is exactly the kind of restaurant that makes you fall in love with Vietnamese cuisine!

Highly recommended! We would happily come back again! 🇻🇳❤️
